```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6)

pkgs <- c("ggplot2", "ape", "phangorn", "pheatmap", "ggrepel", "dplyr", "tidyr", "knitr", "scales", "vegan")
new  <- pkgs[!pkgs %in% rownames(installed.packages())]
if (length(new)) install.packages(new)
invisible(lapply(pkgs, library, character.only = TRUE))

# ---------------- inputs ----------------
base      <- path.expand("~/SS_WGS/results")        # downloaded from MSI (30_collect_results.sh)
rnaseq_dir <- path.expand("~/SS_WGS/rnaseq_DE")      # Ch3 pathogen DE tables (csv/tsv), optional
meta_file <- file.path(base, "isolate_metadata.csv") # optional: isolate,host,origin,year,<phenotypes>
CLONE_SNPS <- 1000                                   # isolates closer than this = same clonal lineage
DEL_COV    <- 0.1                                    # relative gene depth below this = gene deleted

out_dir <- file.path(base, "report_tables"); dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
figdir  <- file.path(base, "figures");       dir.create(figdir,  showWarnings = FALSE)
f   <- function(...) file.path(base, ...)
has <- function(p) file.exists(p) && file.size(p) > 0

# ---------------- RNA-seq isolates (Ch3) ----------------
rnaseq <- data.frame(
  isolate   = c("WISS47", "JS659", "Xtra7", "MNSS6", "SSPotter", "BN172"),
  phenotype = c("Low aggressive", "Low aggressive", "High aggressive", "High aggressive",
                "Soybean-specific", "Sunflower-specific"))
pheno_col <- c(`Low aggressive` = "#2c7bb6", `High aggressive` = "#d7191c",
               `Soybean-specific` = "#1a9641", `Sunflower-specific` = "#fdae61")
R6 <- rnaseq$isolate

meta <- if (has(meta_file)) read.csv(meta_file, check.names = FALSE) else NULL

# ---------------- core data ----------------
dist <- as.matrix(read.delim(f("popgen", "snp_distance.tsv"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
iso  <- rownames(dist)

# clonal lineages: single-linkage groups of isolates < CLONE_SNPS apart
hc <- hclust(as.dist(dist), method = "single")
cl <- cutree(hc, h = CLONE_SNPS)
sz <- table(cl)
lin_order <- names(sort(sz, decreasing = TRUE))
lineage <- setNames(paste0("L", match(as.character(cl), lin_order)), names(cl))
lineage_size <- setNames(as.integer(sz[as.character(cl)]), names(cl))
lineage[lineage_size == 1] <- "singleton"

# gene-level data from 14_gene_level.sh (optional until that step is run)
gl <- function(x) f("gene_level", x)
HAVE_GL <- has(gl("variant_effects.tsv.gz"))
if (HAVE_GL) {
  ve <- read.delim(gzfile(gl("variant_effects.tsv.gz")),
                   colClasses = c(ref = "character", alt = "character", genotypes = "character",
                                  hgvs_c = "character", hgvs_p = "character", distance = "character"))
  vcf_iso <- colnames(read.delim(gl("gene_isolate_HIGH.tsv"), nrows = 1, check.names = FALSE))[-1]
  gpos <- setNames(seq_along(vcf_iso), vcf_iso)
  gt_of <- function(ids) sapply(ids, function(s) substr(ve$genotypes, gpos[[s]], gpos[[s]]))
  ginfo <- read.delim(gl("gene_info.tsv"), colClasses = c(kog_class = "character", interpro = "character",
                                                          kegg = "character", kog_def = "character"))
}
HAVE_COV <- has(gl("gene_isolate_relcov.tsv"))
if (HAVE_COV) {
  relcov <- as.matrix(read.delim(gl("gene_isolate_relcov.tsv"), row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE))
  # genes with low depth in Model_1980 (the reference strain itself) cannot be mapped reliably
  # (repeats, multi-copy families) -> not callable as deletions in any isolate
  ref_iso <- intersect(c("Model_1980"), colnames(relcov))
  n_unmappable <- if (length(ref_iso)) sum(relcov[, ref_iso] < 0.5) else 0
  if (length(ref_iso)) relcov <- relcov[relcov[, ref_iso] >= 0.5, , drop = FALSE]
}
fun_of <- function(g) {
  if (!HAVE_GL) return(rep("", length(g)))
  i <- match(g, ginfo$gene)
  lab <- ifelse(nzchar(ginfo$interpro[i]), ginfo$interpro[i], ginfo$kog_def[i])
  lab[is.na(lab)] <- ""
  paste0(ifelse(!is.na(i) & ginfo$cys_rich_SSP[i] == 1, "[Cys-rich SSP] ",
                ifelse(!is.na(i) & ginfo$small_secreted[i] == 1, "[SSP] ",
                       ifelse(!is.na(i) & ginfo$signalP[i] == 1, "[secreted] ", ""))), substr(lab, 1, 90))
}
status <- function(ok) if (ok) "✅" else "⏳ not yet"
```

| Input | Status |
|---|---|
| Population genetics (steps 12–13) | `r status(TRUE)` |
| Gene-level variation (step 14) | `r status(HAVE_GL)` |
| Gene deletions / copy number (step 14) | `r status(HAVE_COV)` |
| Ch3 RNA-seq DE tables (`~/SS_WGS/rnaseq_DE/`) | `r status(dir.exists(rnaseq_dir) && length(list.files(rnaseq_dir, "\\.(csv|tsv|txt)$")) > 0)` |
| Isolate metadata (`isolate_metadata.csv`) | `r status(!is.null(meta))` |

# Key findings

```{r key-numbers, echo=FALSE}
n_lin  <- length(unique(cl)); n_clonal <- sum(lineage != "singleton")
d6 <- dist[R6, R6]
pair_xs <- dist["Xtra7", "SSPotter"]
d_low <- dist["WISS47", "JS659"]
nn <- function(s) { d <- dist[s, setdiff(iso, s)]; names(which.min(d)) }
```

- **Highly clonal population.** The `r length(iso)` isolates fall into **`r n_lin` clonal lineages** (< `r CLONE_SNPS` SNPs apart); `r n_clonal` isolates share a lineage with at least one other isolate. The largest lineage holds `r max(sz)` isolates.
- **Aggressiveness phenotype does not follow lineage.** The high-aggressive generalist **Xtra7** and the soybean-specific **SSPotter** are near-clones (**`r pair_xs` SNPs**), while the two low-aggressive isolates WISS47 and JS659 are among the most distant pairs (**`r format(d_low, big.mark=",")` SNPs**).
- So differences in aggressiveness and host range arise **within** clonal backgrounds, from a small number of variants, gene gains/losses, or regulation — the mechanisms the RNA-seq can see. Sections 3–6 list those candidate genes.
- JS659 is near-identical to the reference strain 1980 (`r dist["JS659", "Model_1980"]` SNPs to Model_1980) — worth confirming against culture records.

# 1. Population structure

## 1.1 Clonal lineages

```{r lineages}
lin_tab <- data.frame(isolate = iso, lineage = lineage[iso], size = lineage_size[iso]) %>%
  mutate(rnaseq = ifelse(isolate %in% R6, rnaseq$phenotype[match(isolate, R6)], "")) %>%
  group_by(lineage) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), isolates = paste(sort(isolate), collapse = ", "),
            RNAseq_isolates = paste(na.omit(ifelse(rnaseq != "", paste0(isolate, " (", rnaseq, ")"), NA)), collapse = "; "),
            max_within_SNPs = if (n() > 1 && lineage[1] != "singleton") max(dist[isolate, isolate]) else NA_real_) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))
kable(lin_tab)
write.csv(lin_tab, file.path(out_dir, "clonal_lineages.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r dist-hist, fig.height=4}
d <- dist[upper.tri(dist)]
ggplot(data.frame(d = d), aes(d + 1)) + geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = CLONE_SNPS, linetype = 2, colour = "red") +

       title = "Two classes of isolate pairs: clonal (left) and unrelated (right)",
       subtitle = sprintf("Dashed line: lineage threshold (%d SNPs)", CLONE_SNPS)) + theme_bw()
```

## 1.2 Phylogeny

```{r tree, fig.height=10}
tr <- phangorn::midpoint(read.tree(f("popgen", "SS_WGS_snps.treefile")))
lv <- sort(unique(lineage[lineage != "singleton"]))
lin_col <- setNames(hue_pal()(length(lv)), lv); lin_col["singleton"] <- "grey40"
tipc <- lin_col[lineage[tr$tip.label]]
draw_tree <- function() {
  plot(tr, cex = 0.75, tip.color = tipc, font = ifelse(tr$tip.label %in% R6, 2, 1),
       no.margin = TRUE, label.offset = 0.004)
  bs <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(tr$node.label))
  nodelabels(ifelse(!is.na(bs) & bs >= 95, "*", ""), frame = "none", cex = 0.9, col = "grey20")
  k <- match(R6, tr$tip.label)
  tiplabels(tip = k, pch = 21, bg = pheno_col[rnaseq$phenotype], col = "black", cex = 1.6)
  legend("bottomleft", legend = names(pheno_col), pt.bg = pheno_col, pch = 21, bty = "n",
         cex = 0.75, title = "RNA-seq isolates")
  add.scale.bar(cex = 0.6)
}
draw_tree()
pdf(file.path(figdir, "tree_lineages_rnaseq.pdf"), width = 7.5, height = 10); draw_tree(); invisible(dev.off())
```

Tip colours = clonal lineage; **bold + dot** = RNA-seq isolates (dot colour = phenotype); `*` = bootstrap ≥ 95.

# 2. The six RNA-seq isolates in genomic context

```{r six-heatmap, fig.width=6.5, fig.height=5.5}
ann <- data.frame(row.names = R6, phenotype = rnaseq$phenotype, lineage = lineage[R6])
pheatmap(d6, display_numbers = format(d6, big.mark = ","), number_color = "black", fontsize_number = 8,
         annotation_row = ann, annotation_col = ann, color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "grey30"))(50),
         annotation_colors = list(phenotype = pheno_col, lineage = lin_col[unique(lineage[R6])]),
         main = "Pairwise SNP differences among the RNA-seq isolates")
```

```{r six-table}
six <- rnaseq %>% mutate(
  lineage = lineage[isolate], lineage_size = lineage_size[isolate],
  nearest_isolate = sapply(isolate, nn),
  SNPs_to_nearest = sapply(isolate, function(s) min(dist[s, setdiff(iso, s)])),
  lineage_mates = sapply(isolate, function(s) paste(setdiff(names(lineage)[lineage == lineage[s] & lineage != "singleton"], s), collapse = ", ")))
kable(six)
write.csv(six, file.path(out_dir, "rnaseq_isolates_genomic_context.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

within_low  <- dist["WISS47", "JS659"]; within_high <- dist["Xtra7", "MNSS6"]
between <- as.vector(dist[c("WISS47", "JS659"), c("Xtra7", "MNSS6")])
```

Isolates with the **same** phenotype are not genetically closer: low-aggressive pair `r format(within_low, big.mark=",")` SNPs, high-aggressive pair `r format(within_high, big.mark=",")` SNPs, versus low/high pairs `r paste(format(range(between), big.mark=","), collapse = " to ")` SNPs. Phenotype is therefore not a property of genetic background.

# 3. A near-clonal pair with different phenotypes: Xtra7 vs SSPotter

Xtra7 (high-aggressive generalist) and SSPotter (soybean-specific) differ by only **`r pair_xs` SNPs** genome-wide. Any genomic cause of their phenotypic difference must be among these few variants or in gene-content differences — a short, testable candidate list.

```{r pair-function}
pair_diff <- function(a, b, cats = c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "LOW", "promoter1kb", "genic_noncoding")) {
  ga <- substr(ve$genotypes, gpos[[a]], gpos[[a]]); gb <- substr(ve$genotypes, gpos[[b]], gpos[[b]])
  k <- ga %in% c("0", "1") & gb %in% c("0", "1") & ga != gb & ve$category %in% cats
  out <- ve[k, c("chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt", "gene", "category", "effect", "hgvs_p")]
  out[[a]] <- ifelse(ga[k] == "1", "ALT", "ref"); out[[b]] <- ifelse(gb[k] == "1", "ALT", "ref")
  out$function_ <- fun_of(out$gene)
  out[order(match(out$category, c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "promoter1kb", "LOW", "genic_noncoding"))), ]
}
```

```{r xtra7-ssp, eval=HAVE_GL}
xs <- pair_diff("Xtra7", "SSPotter")
xs_counts <- count(xs, category, name = "variants")
kable(xs_counts, caption = "Variants in or near genes that differ between Xtra7 and SSPotter")
kable(subset(xs, category %in% c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "promoter1kb")),
      caption = "Candidate genes: protein-changing or promoter (≤1 kb) differences", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(xs, file.path(out_dir, "Xtra7_vs_SSPotter_variants.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r xtra7-ssp-cov, eval=HAVE_COV}
cn <- relcov[, c("Xtra7", "SSPotter")]
cd <- data.frame(gene = rownames(cn), Xtra7 = cn[, 1], SSPotter = cn[, 2]) %>%
  filter((Xtra7 < DEL_COV & SSPotter >= 0.5) | (SSPotter < DEL_COV & Xtra7 >= 0.5) |
         (pmax(Xtra7, SSPotter) >= 1.8 & pmin(Xtra7, SSPotter) < 1.3)) %>%
  mutate(difference = case_when(Xtra7 < DEL_COV ~ "absent in Xtra7", SSPotter < DEL_COV ~ "absent in SSPotter",
                                Xtra7 >= 1.8 ~ "extra copy in Xtra7", TRUE ~ "extra copy in SSPotter"),
         function_ = fun_of(gene))
kable(cd, digits = 2, caption = "Gene presence / copy-number differences between Xtra7 and SSPotter", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cd, file.path(out_dir, "Xtra7_vs_SSPotter_gene_content.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 4. Gene content variation (deletions and duplications)

Relative read depth per reference gene (1 = single copy, ~0 = deleted, ≥ 1.8 = duplicated). `r if (HAVE_COV) sprintf("%d genes with low depth in Model_1980 (the reference strain itself, so unmappable rather than deleted) are excluded, leaving %s genes.", n_unmappable, format(nrow(relcov), big.mark=",")) else ""`

```{r cov-summary, eval=HAVE_COV}
iso_cov <- intersect(colnames(relcov), iso)
del <- relcov[, iso_cov] < DEL_COV; dup <- relcov[, iso_cov] >= 1.8
per_iso <- data.frame(isolate = iso_cov, genes_deleted = colSums(del), genes_duplicated = colSums(dup),
                      lineage = lineage[iso_cov], rnaseq = rnaseq$phenotype[match(iso_cov, R6)])
ggplot(per_iso, aes(reorder(isolate, genes_deleted), genes_deleted, fill = !is.na(rnaseq))) +
  geom_col() + coord_flip() + scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey60", `TRUE` = "firebrick"),
                                                labels = c("other", "RNA-seq isolate"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Reference genes absent (relative depth < 0.1)") + theme_bw()

variable <- rowSums(del) > 0 & rowSums(del) < ncol(del)
cat(sprintf("%d reference genes are absent from some isolates but present in others (%d absent from all).\n",
            sum(variable), sum(rowSums(del) == ncol(del))))
```

```{r cov-heatmap, eval=HAVE_COV, fig.height=7}
if (sum(variable) > 1) {
  m <- (relcov[variable, iso_cov] >= DEL_COV) * 1
  annc <- data.frame(row.names = iso_cov, lineage = lineage[iso_cov],
                     RNAseq = ifelse(iso_cov %in% R6, rnaseq$phenotype[match(iso_cov, R6)], "other"))
  pheatmap(m, show_rownames = sum(variable) <= 60, fontsize_row = 6, fontsize_col = 7,
           color = c("white", "darkblue"), legend = FALSE, annotation_col = annc,
           annotation_colors = list(lineage = lin_col, RNAseq = c(pheno_col, other = "grey90")),
           main = sprintf("%d variably present reference genes (blue = present)", sum(variable)))
}
```

```{r cov-function, eval=HAVE_COV && HAVE_GL}
gi <- ginfo[match(rownames(relcov), ginfo$gene), ]
enrich <- function(flag, label) {
  ok <- !is.na(flag); t <- table(factor(variable[ok], c(FALSE, TRUE)), factor(flag[ok] == 1, c(FALSE, TRUE)))
  ft <- fisher.test(t)
  data.frame(gene_class = label, variable_genes_in_class = t[2, 2], variable_total = sum(t[2, ]),
             pct_variable = 100 * t[2, 2] / sum(t[2, ]), pct_all_genes = 100 * sum(t[, 2]) / sum(t),
             odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), p = ft$p.value)
}
kable(rbind(enrich(gi$signalP, "Secreted (SignalP)"), enrich(gi$small_secreted, "Small secreted (≤300 aa)"),
            enrich(gi$cys_rich_SSP, "Cys-rich small secreted")), digits = 3,
      caption = "Are variably present genes enriched for secreted / effector-like proteins?")
```

```{r cov-rnaseq, eval=HAVE_COV}
d6m <- relcov[, R6] < DEL_COV
v6 <- rowSums(d6m) > 0 & rowSums(d6m) < length(R6)
gc6 <- data.frame(gene = rownames(relcov)[v6],
                  absent_in = apply(d6m[v6, , drop = FALSE], 1, function(r) paste(R6[r], collapse = ", ")),
                  function_ = fun_of(rownames(relcov)[v6]))
cat(sprintf("%d genes are present in some RNA-seq isolates and absent in others.\n", nrow(gc6)))
kable(head(gc6, 80), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gc6, file.path(out_dir, "rnaseq_isolates_gene_presence_absence.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

# 5. Protein-changing variation

```{r hm-genes, eval=HAVE_GL}
seg <- ve$n_alt > 0 & ve$n_alt < ve$n_called            # variable among isolates (not fixed vs reference)
hm  <- ve[seg & ve$category %in% c("HIGH", "MODERATE"), ]
gene_var <- hm %>% group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(HIGH = sum(category == "HIGH"), MODERATE = sum(category == "MODERATE"), total = n(),
            effects = paste(head(unique(effect), 4), collapse = "; ")) %>%
  arrange(desc(HIGH), desc(total)) %>% mutate(function_ = fun_of(gene))
cat(sprintf("%d genes carry at least one segregating protein-changing variant (%d with HIGH impact).\n",
            nrow(gene_var), sum(gene_var$HIGH > 0)))
kable(head(gene_var, 40), caption = "Most variable genes (segregating HIGH / MODERATE variants)", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(gene_var, file.path(out_dir, "genes_protein_changing_variation.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

gi2 <- ginfo %>% mutate(n_hm = gene_var$total[match(gene, gene_var$gene)], n_hm = ifelse(is.na(n_hm), 0, n_hm),
                        has_hm = n_hm > 0)
kable(gi2 %>% group_by(class = ifelse(cys_rich_SSP == 1, "Cys-rich SSP", ifelse(small_secreted == 1, "Small secreted",
                                ifelse(signalP == 1, "Secreted (other)", "Not secreted")))) %>%
        summarise(genes = n(), pct_with_protein_changes = 100 * mean(has_hm), mean_variants = mean(n_hm)),
      digits = 2, caption = "Protein-changing variation by protein class")
```

## 5.1 Alleles that separate the aggressiveness groups (RNA-seq isolates)

High = Xtra7, MNSS6; Low = WISS47, JS659. A variant "separates" the groups when both high isolates share one allele and both low isolates the other. With only 2 vs 2, many such alleles arise by chance from lineage, so the same count is shown for the other two ways of splitting these four isolates as a baseline.

```{r separate, eval=HAVE_GL}
g4 <- gt_of(c("Xtra7", "MNSS6", "WISS47", "JS659"))
splits <- list(`High vs Low (real)` = list(c("Xtra7", "MNSS6"), c("WISS47", "JS659")),
               `Xtra7+WISS47 vs MNSS6+JS659` = list(c("Xtra7", "WISS47"), c("MNSS6", "JS659")),
               `Xtra7+JS659 vs MNSS6+WISS47` = list(c("Xtra7", "JS659"), c("MNSS6", "WISS47")))
sep_rows <- function(a, b) {
  A <- g4[, a, drop = FALSE]; B <- g4[, b, drop = FALSE]
  (rowSums(A == "1") == 2 & rowSums(B == "0") == 2) | (rowSums(A == "0") == 2 & rowSums(B == "1") == 2)
}
cats <- c("HIGH", "MODERATE", "promoter1kb")
base_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(splits), function(n) {
  k <- sep_rows(splits[[n]][[1]], splits[[n]][[2]])
  data.frame(split = n, HIGH = sum(k & ve$category == "HIGH"), MODERATE = sum(k & ve$category == "MODERATE"),
             promoter1kb = sum(k & ve$category == "promoter1kb"),
             genes = length(unique(ve$gene[k & ve$category %in% cats])))
}))
kable(base_tab, caption = "Separating variants: real grouping vs the two alternative groupings")
k <- sep_rows(c("Xtra7", "MNSS6"), c("WISS47", "JS659")) & ve$category %in% cats
sep <- ve[k, c("chrom", "pos", "ref", "alt", "gene", "category", "effect", "hgvs_p")]
sep$high_allele <- ifelse(g4[k, "Xtra7"] == "1", "ALT", "ref")
sep$function_ <- fun_of(sep$gene)
write.csv(sep, file.path(out_dir, "variants_separating_high_vs_low.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
kable(head(sep[order(match(sep$category, cats)), ], 60), row.names = FALSE,
      caption = "Genes with alleles shared by both high-aggressive and absent from both low-aggressive isolates (or vice versa)")
```

# 6. Linking to the RNA-seq differentially expressed genes (Ch3)

Put the pathogen DE tables from Ch3 (any `.csv`/`.tsv` with an `SS1G_` gene column or row names; optional `log2FoldChange`, `padj`) into **`~/SS_WGS/rnaseq_DE/`**. Each file is treated as one DE list. For every list, the report asks whether DE genes are more often genomically variable **among the six RNA-seq isolates** than genes overall — i.e. whether part of the expression differences has a cis-genetic explanation (gene absent, protein-changing allele, or promoter variant).

```{r load-de}
de_files <- if (dir.exists(rnaseq_dir)) list.files(rnaseq_dir, "\\.(csv|tsv|txt)$", full.names = TRUE) else character()
read_de <- function(p) {
  x <- if (grepl("\\.csv$", p)) read.csv(p, check.names = FALSE) else read.delim(p, check.names = FALSE)
  cand <- c(list(rownames = rownames(x)), lapply(x, as.character))
  hit  <- sapply(cand, function(v) mean(grepl("SS1G_[0-9]+", v)))
  if (max(hit) < 0.5) return(NULL)
  ids <- regmatches(cand[[which.max(hit)]], regexpr("SS1G_[0-9]+", cand[[which.max(hit)]]))
  keep <- grepl("SS1G_[0-9]+", cand[[which.max(hit)]])
  lfc  <- grep("log2FoldChange|^logFC$|log2FC", names(x), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  padj <- grep("^padj$|FDR|adj", names(x), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
  out <- data.frame(gene = ids, log2FC = if (!is.na(lfc)) x[[lfc]][keep] else NA,
                    padj = if (!is.na(padj)) x[[padj]][keep] else NA)
  if (!is.na(padj)) out <- subset(out, !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05)
  out[!duplicated(out$gene), ]
}
de <- Filter(Negate(is.null), setNames(lapply(de_files, read_de), sub("\\.(csv|tsv|txt)$", "", basename(de_files))))
HAVE_DE <- length(de) > 0
if (HAVE_DE) kable(data.frame(DE_list = names(de), genes = sapply(de, nrow)), row.names = FALSE) else
  cat("No DE tables found yet in", rnaseq_dir, "\n")
```

```{r de-enrich, eval=HAVE_DE && HAVE_GL, fig.height=5}
all_genes <- ginfo$gene
g6 <- gt_of(R6)
v6var <- function(cats) {
  k <- ve$category %in% cats & rowSums(g6 == "1") > 0 & rowSums(g6 == "0") > 0
  unique(ve$gene[k])
}
sets <- list(`Protein-changing (HIGH/MODERATE)` = v6var(c("HIGH", "MODERATE")),
             `Promoter (≤1 kb)` = v6var("promoter1kb"))
if (HAVE_COV) sets$`Present/absent` <- gc6$gene
res <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(de), function(n) do.call(rbind, lapply(names(sets), function(s) {
  inDE <- all_genes %in% de[[n]]$gene; inV <- all_genes %in% sets[[s]]
  ft <- fisher.test(table(factor(inDE, c(FALSE, TRUE)), factor(inV, c(FALSE, TRUE))))
  data.frame(DE_list = n, variation = s, DE_genes = sum(inDE), DE_variable = sum(inDE & inV),
             pct_DE = 100 * mean(inV[inDE]), pct_background = 100 * mean(inV[!inDE]),
             odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), p = ft$p.value)
}))))
res$FDR <- p.adjust(res$p, "BH")
kable(res, digits = 3, row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(res, file.path(out_dir, "DE_genes_genomic_variation_enrichment.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
ggplot(res, aes(variation, pct_DE - pct_background, fill = FDR < 0.05)) + geom_col() + coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ DE_list) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = "grey60", `TRUE` = "firebrick")) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% DE genes variable minus % background genes variable") + theme_bw()
```

```{r de-explain, eval=HAVE_DE && HAVE_GL}
carriers <- function(gene, cats) {
  k <- ve$gene == gene & ve$category %in% cats
  if (!any(k)) return("")
  c6 <- g6[k, , drop = FALSE]
  s <- R6[colSums(c6 == "1") > 0]
  if (length(s) %in% c(0, length(R6))) "" else paste(s, collapse = ", ")
}
explain <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(de), function(n) {
  g <- de[[n]]$gene
  data.frame(DE_list = n, gene = g, log2FC = de[[n]]$log2FC,
             absent_in = if (HAVE_COV) gc6$absent_in[match(g, gc6$gene)] else NA,
             protein_change_in = sapply(g, carriers, cats = c("HIGH", "MODERATE")),
             promoter_variant_in = sapply(g, carriers, cats = "promoter1kb"),
             function_ = fun_of(g))
}))
explain$absent_in[is.na(explain$absent_in)] <- ""
explained <- subset(explain, nzchar(absent_in) | nzchar(protein_change_in) | nzchar(promoter_variant_in))
cat(sprintf("%d of %d DE gene entries have a genomic difference among the six RNA-seq isolates.\n",
            nrow(explained), nrow(explain)))
kable(head(explained[order(nzchar(explained$absent_in), decreasing = TRUE), ], 80), row.names = FALSE, digits = 2)
write.csv(explained, file.path(out_dir, "DE_genes_with_genomic_differences.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

How to read this: a pathogen gene that is DE between isolates **and** is absent in some isolates explains the expression difference trivially (no gene, no transcript). Genes with promoter or protein-changing alleles carried by the higher- (or lower-) expressing isolates are the cis-regulatory and functional candidates worth discussing in Ch3.

# 7. Phenotype vs genotype across the panel (CH4)

Needs `isolate_metadata.csv` with numeric phenotype columns (e.g. lesion length on each crop).

```{r ch4, eval=!is.null(meta)}
num <- names(meta)[sapply(meta, is.numeric) & !tolower(names(meta)) %in% c("year")]
mm  <- meta[meta$isolate %in% iso & complete.cases(meta[, num, drop = FALSE]), ]
if (length(num) && nrow(mm) >= 8) {
  ph <- dist(scale(mm[, num, drop = FALSE])); gd <- as.dist(dist[mm$isolate, mm$isolate])
  mt <- vegan::mantel(gd, ph, permutations = 9999)
  cat(sprintf("Mantel test, SNP distance vs phenotype distance (%s), n = %d isolates: r = %.3f, p = %.4f\n",
              paste(num, collapse = ", "), nrow(mm), mt$statistic, mt$signif))
  mm$lineage <- lineage[mm$isolate]
  for (v in num) {
    kt <- kruskal.test(mm[[v]] ~ factor(mm$lineage))
    print(ggplot(mm, aes(reorder(lineage, .data[[v]], median), .data[[v]])) + geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
            geom_jitter(width = 0.15) + labs(x = "Clonal lineage", y = v,
            title = sprintf("%s by lineage (Kruskal-Wallis p = %.3g)", v, kt$p.value)) + theme_bw())
  }
} else cat("Add numeric phenotype columns for at least 8 isolates to run this section.\n")
```

# Appendix A — Data quality

```{r qc, echo=FALSE}
cov <- if (has(f("qc", "coverage_per_isolate.tsv"))) read.delim(f("qc", "coverage_per_isolate.tsv")) else NULL
mp  <- if (has(f("qc", "mapping_rates.tsv"))) read.delim(f("qc", "mapping_rates.tsv")) else NULL
bu  <- if (has(f("assembly", "busco_summary.tsv"))) read.delim(f("assembly", "busco_summary.tsv")) else NULL
dc  <- if (has(f("assembly", "decontam_summary.tsv"))) read.delim(f("assembly", "decontam_summary.tsv")) else NULL
an  <- if (has(f("annotation", "annotation_summary.tsv"))) read.delim(f("annotation", "annotation_summary.tsv")) else NULL
q <- c(
  if (!is.null(cov)) sprintf("Coverage after trimming: %.0f–%.0fx (median %.0fx).", min(cov$trim_coverage_x), max(cov$trim_coverage_x), median(cov$trim_coverage_x)),
  if (!is.null(mp))  sprintf("Reads mapped to 1980 UF-70: %.1f–%.1f%%; genome breadth %.1f–%.1f%%.", min(mp$mapped_pct), max(mp$mapped_pct), min(mp$breadth_pct), max(mp$breadth_pct)),
  if (!is.null(bu))  sprintf("De novo assemblies: BUSCO complete %.1f–%.1f%%, duplicated ≤ %.1f%% (no mixed cultures).", min(bu$complete_pct[bu$assembly != "Ss_ref"]), max(bu$complete_pct), max(bu$duplicated_pct[bu$assembly != "Ss_ref"])),
  if (!is.null(dc))  sprintf("Bacterial contigs (%d isolates, %.1f–%.1f Mb) removed before annotation; cleaned assemblies %.1f–%.1f Mb.", sum(dc$removed_Mb > 1), min(dc$removed_Mb[dc$removed_Mb > 1]), max(dc$removed_Mb), min(dc$clean_Mb), max(dc$clean_Mb)),
  if (!is.null(an))  sprintf("Predicted genes per isolate: %s–%s (median %s).", format(min(an$genes), big.mark=","), format(max(an$genes), big.mark=","), format(median(an$genes), big.mark=",")))
cat(paste("-", q), sep = "\n")
```
